header.title: IEC 81346-2:2019 component classes (letter codes), as published in the Wikipedia article 'IEC 81346'

sources.note: Upstream source cited by Wikipedia: Czech CCI classification (Agentura CAS), derived from ISO/IEC 81346. Not reachable when retrieved.

licence.attribution: Data from the Wikipedia article 'IEC 81346' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEC_81346), by Wikipedia contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reformatted to JSON by the uniwire project (columns split into code/level/parent, hierarchical description added, one malformed row dropped). This file is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

notes: Titles follow the CCI classification and may differ slightly from the wording of IEC 81346-2:2019 itself.
No French titles are available from a legitimate free source: 'fr' is null.
'description' is the class path built from the parent titles (the source table has no definitions).
Titles are reproduced verbatim, including source typos (e.g. 'Liqiud lamp', 'Angle xwitch').
